name: web-help-router-with-two-step-questions-and-painterly-answer-preview
title: Help section 'Two questions instead of a search box': step 1 of 2 with three bordered options and Next, beside a painting with a floating answer card
whatItIs: A white page with a small HELP tag, a large light headline and a right paragraph, a left form with 'Step 1 of 2', a question 'What is this about?', three bordered option cards (Billing and invoices, Getting into the account, Data going in or out) and a black Next, a right image of a green-blue painting with a white card showing a sample question and answer with small tags, and a grey 'Still not it?' box with a Write to support button.
whatItMeans: Thoughtful and calm; two simple questions replace a search box and the painting adds warmth.
techniques: Guide users with two steps instead of search.
Show a sample answer over a painting.

vocabulary.definition: A form asking one question at a time.
A bordered card with a title and description.
A sample response shown in a card.
A grey box offering another way to get help.
